unsupportedHorizons.reason: No complete 18-year-wait plus four-year attendance outcome with the required origin training history in comparable 2000–2023 prices.

status: Retrospective school and synthetic funding evidence; current forward probability calibration remains unestablished.
limitations: Published revised price histories are not original publication vintages. Cohorts include established positive-price on-campus schools only.
Origin-only cohort reconstruction differs from the full-window survivor panels in the current forward bundle; this diagnoses the model process, not current SPF anchors.
Six schools per origin/sector/type and at most 200 hierarchy training schools bound runtime; school selection is identity-based, not a census.
Related sectors, plans, schools and overlapping outcomes share economic years. Case counts are not independent evidence.
The final economic years have appeared in earlier studies; this frozen comparison is retrospective, not a new untouched experiment.
Reconstructed instruments and fixed synthetic aid, deposits and household choices do not represent observed family behavior.
Passing a cost qualification does not activate a model or validate its funding probabilities. Missing long-horizon support remains explicit.
scoreNormalization: Known four-year origin category budget; weights do not depend on realized outcomes.
